note: Budget for `node scripts/consumer-size.mjs --check` (CI, P8): the cost, minified + gzip, of a Vue app built from each fixture in fixtures/consumer (TanStack, the core and the protocol bundled), minus the same app without the table (fixtures/consumer/vue-only.ts). `measuredGzipBytes` is the value when the budget was last set; `maxGzipBytes` is that plus 5%, capped at `ceilingGzipBytes`. Measured on Windows locally; the 5% margin covers the CI runner. A deliberate growth raises the budget (and the ceiling when needed) in the same change, with a one-line reason in `history`.
history: 2.2.8: 10224 B (2.2.7 was 8279 B). +1945 B for column pinning (measured offsets, one ResizeObserver), column resizing (pointer, keyboard and autofit on an accessible separator) and the header slot.

2.2.11: 10792 B (+568 B since 2.2.8). The 2.2.9 to 2.2.11 fixes plus the echo memory of the filter drafts: a bounded memory (last 8 emits per column) that counts the older unanswered ones, so a late answer neither rewinds the input nor drops the emits still in flight (C-18).
2.2.12: 10815 B (+23 B). C-04, C-13, C-14: pending filter drafts are applied in one `filter` update (#31). The budget follows the measure plus 5%. This is the v3 baseline (ADR 0001).

3.0.0-next.0 (PR-C): one entry per fixture. `component` (QueryTable) 28490 B, `composable` (useQueryTable) 20242 B. The planned ceilings (component 23000 B, composable 16500 B) were set before the core existed; the core fixture alone is 17564 B (TanStack table-core with five features and both plugins), and the Vue package adds row expansion, column pinning, @tanstack/vue-table, the composable and, for the component, its parts. Ceilings raised to measure plus 5%, rounded up (K7: size is not a blocker; ceilings guard drift).

3.1.0 (PR-D1): component 30022 B, composable 21640 B when the budget was set; right pinning and the reorder handle bring them to 31164 B and 21750 B, within it. Column visibility, column order and the column controls (TanStack columnVisibility and columnOrdering), the update:columns write-back, right pinning (measured --qt-pin-right), the reorder handle (pointer drag, keys, focus kept; component only).

3.1.0 (PR-D2, 2026-10-06): component 32224 B (+1060 B since PR-D1's 31164 B), composable 22652 B (+902 B). Row pinning: TanStack rowPinningFeature, the controlled rowPinning map and update:rowPinning, the body drawn in top, center, bottom order, rowPinned and pinRow in the cell slot. Budgets set to measure plus 5%, ceilings rounded up to the next 500 B.
3.1.0 (PR-L3, 2026-10-06): local-composable 5739 B. useLocalQuery over the local evaluator. Budget 6026 B (measure plus 5%), ceiling 7000 B (measure times 1.2 rounded up to 500 B).

3.2.0 (2026-10-07): component 36260 B (+3933 B over next at 32327 B; composable unchanged). Virtual rows (own windowing: prefix sums, one ResizeObserver, scroll correction, kept focus, print, scrollToIndex) and infinite scroll (IntersectionObserver trigger, load-more slot); ADR 0010. Budget set to measure plus 5%, ceiling rounded up to the next 500 B.

3.2.0 (PR #79, 2026-10-07): component 36390 B (+130 B over next at 36260 B). C-22: a keyed clear all hands the focus to the first filter (focusFirstFilter, one nextTick after the click). Budget set to measure plus 5%; ceiling unchanged.

3.3.0 (change flash, 2026-10-07): component 39088 B (+2698 B over the 36390 B budget measure; composable 22666 B, unchanged within noise). The flash controller and the core row-change tracker (C-92 to C-95, ADR 0011) are 2349 B of it, measured by building without the controller (36739 B); the rest is the off path (one watcher of `flash`) and the bindings in the body. A dynamic import of the controller would move those 2349 B to a second chunk loaded when `flash` turns on, but leaves a window after that where a change is not seen, adds a chunk to the package and makes the start asynchronous; kept static. Budget set to measure plus 5%, ceiling rounded up to the next 500 B.

3.3.0 (change flash, review fixes, 2026-10-07): component 39223 B (+135 B). A cell mounted under a flashing row is bound to that row's flash, the clock is read only when a mark exists, a zero duration is read once a frame, and the timer is set again for an earlier end. Budget set to measure plus 5%; ceiling unchanged.

3.8.0 (scrollBody, 2026-10-16): component 41706 B (+1038 B over next at 40668 B; composable unchanged). The three-table branch of the template, the `col` widths from the header geometry, the sideways scroll listeners, the development warnings and the ARIA roles (C-101, C-102, ADR 0015). Budget set to measure plus 5%, ceiling rounded up to the next 500 B.

3.8.0 (grouped rows, #131, 2026-10-16): component 42780 B (+1074 B over next with scrollBody at 41706 B; +1023 B when measured over 40668 B before scrollBody; composable and local-composable unchanged). `groupBy` and the sticky group row (C-103 to C-105, ADR 0016): the run builder, group rows in the drawn list and in the virtual window (their own measured height, the carried group row of the top group, the sticky cover in scroll alignment), the aria row count and the `group` slot. With `groupBy` unset none of it runs. Budget set to measure plus 5%, ceiling rounded up to the next 500 B.

3.11.0 (row component, ADR 0017, 2026-10-19): component 44107 B (+712 B over next at 43395 B; composable and local-composable unchanged). Each data row is a `TableRow` component written with the compiled-template helpers, with its cells and utilities kept by value and the flash marks cached per row (C-106 to C-108). Budget set to measure plus 5%, ceiling rounded up to the next 500 B.
